body: Can confirm this is a major issue for us.  I had the reverse issue.  With propTypes defined but defaults missing .  This would seem like a valid syntax pattern as our defaults were defined via destructuring within our functional component.   For documentation I would see a defaultProps would be better but IMO this shouldn't break all the stories  in storybook if missing

issue.title: Improve rendering stories error details

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe**
Problem described in issue: https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/issues/14377

> After upgrade from v6.2.0-rc.10 to v6.2.0-rc.11 I got the following error in preview (displayed in UI):
> 
> ```
> Cannot read property 'name' of undefined
> TypeError: Cannot read property 'name' of undefined
>     at createDefaultValue (http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:16438:33)
>     at createBasicPropDef (http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:16464:19)
>     at javaScriptFactory (http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:16501:17)
>     at extractProp (http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:16642:19)
>     at http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:16623:33
>     at Array.map (<anonymous>)
>     at extractComponentSectionObject (http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:16621:26)
>     at extractComponentProps (http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:16634:87)
>     at getPropDefs (http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:13848:106)
>     at extractProps (http://localhost:6007/vendors~main.iframe.bundle.js:13870:11)
> ```
> 
> First of all - **this error is useless. It doesn't point to any place where this occurs.** I spend a lot of time trying to find a place where it happened (we have ~30 components)...


The error message is really difficult to follow. There is no easy way to find out where the error is thrown.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

The error should contain information about:
* Which story is affected
* in which exact place the error happened
* ?


**Are you able to assist to bring the feature to reality?**
no

**Additional context**
See the referenced issuse.
